questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘RAJ’ is coded as ‘87’ and ‘GITA’ is coded as ‘148’. How will ‘VARUN’ be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is :

**Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number.**

RAJ → Total number of letter is 3.

R(18) + A(1) + J(10) = 18 + 1 + 10 = 29

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

29 × 3 = 87

**And,**

GITA → Total number of letter is 4.

G(7) + I(9) + T(20) + A(1) = 7 + 9 + 20 + 1 = 37

Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number

37 × 4 = 148

**Similarly,**

**VARUN** **→ Total number of letter is 5.**

**V(22) + A(1) + R(18) + U(21) + N(14) = 22 + 1 + 18 + 21 + 14 = 76**

**Sum of the positional values of the letters × total number of the letter = number**

**76 × 5 = 380**

Hence, **VARUN** will be written as **“****380”.**

questions.question: The monthly income of three cricketers Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan, from different sources, are in the ratio of 12 : 9 : 7, and their expenditures are in the ratio 15 : 9 : 8. If Ankit saves 25% of his income for future investments, what is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan?
questions.solution:
__**GIVEN:**__

**Income ratio **of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively: **12x : 9x : 7x**

**Expenditures ****ratio **of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively: 

**15y : 9y : 8y**

__**FORMULA:**__

**Savings = Income - Expenditures**

__**CALCULATION:**__

**Saving ****ratio** of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan is respectively:

** (12x - 15y) : (9x - 9y) : (7x - 8y)**

**[Saving ratio = Income ratio - Ependiture ratio]**

Ankit saves 25% of his income, So **saving of Ankit is**

12x - 15y = 25% of 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = (1)/(4) × 12x

⇒ 12x - 15y = 3x

⇒ 9x = 15y

⇒ (x)/(y) = (15)/(9)

 ⇒ (x)/(y) = (5)/(3) (divided by 3)

So, **x = 5; y = 3**

Put the value of x and y saving of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan,

(12x -15y) **:** (9x - 9y) **:** (7x - 8y)

⇒ (12 × 5 - 15 × 3) : (9 × 5 – 9 × 3) : (7 × 5 - 8 × 3)

⇒ (60 - 45) : (45 - 27) : (35 - 24)

⇒ 15 : 18 : 11

Hence, **‘15 : 18 : 11’** is the ratio of the savings of Ankit, Sanjay and Roshan.

• **A production possibilities curve (PPC)** shows the maximum amount of one good that can be produced given a production level for some other good, and given the total amounts of inputs available for the production of both goods, and given the technology of production.
 
• The PPC shows the limits on the outputs of goods because society does not have unlimited resources. And it shows the trade-off society must bear if more of a good is to be produced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8836246348ee42a1c90ff66e9648cc4d50c2935c9f5cb393e9915bd7d76c50f.png] ​

• When the proportionate change in demand produces the same change in the price of the product the demand is referred to as **unitary elastic demand.**

questions.question: Fourteen persons can do a work in 18 days. After 5 days of work, 6 workers left the work, and joined back on the last day of the work. In how many days the work got completed?

**Given:**

14 persons can do a work in 18 days

These 5 workers joined on the last day of work.

**Concept used:**

If each person can do 1unit of work per day then n persons can do 1 × n unit work per day.

**Calculation:**

Let each person can do 1 unit of work per day

So,

⇒ 14 persons can do = 1 × 14 = 14 units/day

⇒ In 18 days, 14 persons can do = 18 × 14 = 252 units (Total work to be done)

Now,

In first 5 days, 14 persons completed

⇒ 14 × 1 × 5 = 70 units

In last day, 14 persons competed

⇒ 14 × 1 = 14 units

Then,

the total work completed in 6 days = 84 units

Now,

Work left =168 units

And persons left = 14 - 6 = 8 persons

So,

Time taken by 8 persons to complete to leftover work

⇒ 168/(8 × 1) = 21 days

So,

time taken to complete the whole work = 5 + 21 + 1 = 27 days

**∴ The work got completed in 27 days.**

• The given sentence "***What is sometimes referred to as a ‘sixth sense' is a power to be aware of things independently of the five ___(5)___ senses, a kind of supernatural sense***.'' is talking about the sixth sense referred independent of the senses connected with the body.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'physical' because the five known senses are connected with our body.
 
• The word 'physical' means **connected with your body rather than your mind**. 
 
 
• Example:* He tends to avoid all **physical** contact*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

The complete passage is:- *The five senses (1) are sight, hearing, taste, touch, and (2) smell. What is sometimes (3) referred to as a ‘sixth sense’ is a power to be aware (4) of things independently of the five (5) physical senses, a kind of supernatural sense.*
